# BiotechTube

> Global biotech intelligence platform — tracks 14,000+ biotech and pharma companies, 54,000+ drug pipeline programs, 1,000+ public company stock tickers, and $7.5T+ in combined market capitalization.

BiotechTube is the "Bloomberg Terminal for Biotech" — a free, open-access data platform for investors, founders, recruiters, and researchers in the life sciences industry. Data is aggregated from Yahoo Finance, ClinicalTrials.gov, SEC filings, RSS news feeds, and proprietary enrichment pipelines.

## Core entity pages

- [Companies ranking](https://biotechtube.io/top-companies): Publicly traded biotech companies ranked by USD market cap. Daily updates.
- [Drug pipeline](https://biotechtube.io/pipelines): All drug programs with clinical phase, indication, NCT IDs, and sponsor company.
- [Funding tracker](https://biotechtube.io/funding): Recent venture rounds (Series A–IPO) with deal sizes and lead investors.
- [Sectors](https://biotechtube.io/sectors): 20+ therapeutic areas with combined market cap and performance metrics.
- [Countries](https://biotechtube.io/countries): 30+ countries ranked by biotech market cap.
- [News](https://biotechtube.io/news): AI-powered market intelligence articles (funding deals, clinical trials, market analysis, company deep dives).

## Feeds

- RSS: https://biotechtube.io/api/feed/rss
- Atom: https://biotechtube.io/api/feed/atom
- JSON Feed: https://biotechtube.io/api/feed/json

## Data & structure

- Sitemap index: https://biotechtube.io/sitemap.xml
- Google News sitemap: https://biotechtube.io/sitemap-news.xml
